semantics.sampling: On each negative edge of clk, q becomes 8'h34 if reset is high; otherwise q becomes the sampled d.
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous; reset transitions alone do not update q.
semantics.hold: q holds between falling edges, including rising edges.
semantics.latency: Update at the sampling falling edge with no additional cycle.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value specified; no initialization is added and the oracle imposes no pre-first-edge value.
semantics.source: problem.txt: active high synchronous reset; reset to 0x34; negative edge of clk

numeric.data_behavior: Bit-exact copy, no arithmetic or signed interpretation

verification.oracle: Original problem: falling-edge sampling and reset priority, checked after nonblocking assignments settle.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original problem gives reset behavior but no initial value.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Leave uninitialized; do not assert a particular value before first falling edge.
